div.div: Safety rules: all I/O is 3.3 V LVCMOS33; never apply 5 V to JC, JE, JD or JA. The ESP32 is powered from its own USB and only signal ground is shared. JC inputs use impedance-matched pairs single-ended; keep leads short.

switch.text: Safety rules: all I/O is 3.3 V LVCMOS33; never apply 5 V to JC, JE, JD or JA. The ESP32 is powered from its own USB and only signal ground is shared. JC inputs use impedance-matched pairs single-ended; keep leads short.
